answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique physical anchor: a registered knoll hosting a low-power beacon whose pigment signature rotates on a public schedule. Nearby witnesses log line-of-sight receipts, and those receipts interlock into a trellis lattice that sets voting weight. Forging N sybils demands N distinct real locations, N beacons, and N energy fees; costs scale linearly with no batch discount, while honest agents pay once.
